text.tspan: Nerve injuries around the hip: sensory areas and motor signs
髋部神经损伤：感觉区与运动表现

text.aria-label: Anterior view (right lower limb) — 前面观（右下肢）

svg.text: 感觉：大腿前外侧椭圆区烧灼、麻木（感觉异
运动：无：纯感觉神经；如有无力应考虑其他
Gait: Normal; long standing or walking
with the hip extended may worsen it.
步态：正常；久站或伸髋行走可加重症状。
Skin: Anterior and medial thigh; medial
感觉：大腿前内侧；小腿和足内侧（隐神经）。
Motor: Weak knee extension; hip flexion
also weak if above the inguinal ligament.
运动：伸膝无力；病变在腹股沟韧带以上时屈
Gait: Knee buckles in stance; patellar
步态：支撑期膝打软；膝反射减弱或消失。
Skin: Patch on the middle of the medial
感觉：大腿内侧中部一小片皮肤。
步态：下肢不稳；髋外旋的划圈步态。
Skin: No skin area: sensation normal.
感觉：无皮肤感觉区：感觉正常。
Motor: Weak hip abduction and internal
运动：髋外展、内旋无力（臀中肌、臀小肌、
Gait: Pelvis drops on the swing side:
步态：摆动侧骨盆下沉：Trendelenburg 征阳
Skin: No skin area of its own: sensation
感觉：无自己的皮肤感觉区：感觉通常正常。
运动：伸髋无力（只支配臀大肌）。
Gait: Trunk lurches back at heel strike;
stairs and rising from a chair are hard.
步态：足跟着地时躯干后倾；上楼和从椅子站
Skin: Most of the leg below the knee and
the foot, sparing the medial leg.
感觉：膝以下小腿大部分和足部，小腿内侧除
Motor: Weak knee flexion and all ankle
运动：屈膝及踝、足全部运动无力。
Gait: Foot drop → steppage gait (hip and
knee lifted high); ankle jerk may drop.
步态：足下垂 → 跨阈步态（高抬髋膝）；跟
Shaded skin areas are approximate: borders overlap and vary between people. The superior and inferior gluteal nerves have no skin area (outlined muscles show what they supply).
阴影皮肤区为大致范围：边界相互重叠，个体间有差异。臀上、臀下神经没有皮肤感觉区（虚线轮廓为其支配的肌肉）。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
